concept: Secrets Manager: automatic DB password rotation
tests: Choosing a service to securely retrieve a DB password at runtime with automatic rotation and no code changes.
expected: AWS Secrets Manager — encrypted storage + built-in rotation (Lambda) for supported DBs; the app always reads the current value. Triggers: "rotated automatically every 30 days", "database password", "without code changes".
why_not: Parameter Store standard parameters — no built-in rotation; env vars and an encrypted S3 object need custom rotation logic.
